description: This plot, titled "BBQ", illustrates the Accuracy of different methods across a varying number of demonstrations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks every 250 units. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with tick marks at 45, 50, and 55. The plot contains four lines. The "Squared-Exponential" line is a dark blue solid line with circle markers; it starts at x=25 with a value of approximately 53, increases to 55 at x=250, and reaches a peak of approximately 56.5 at x=1500. The "Tanh" line is a light blue solid line with circle markers, showing a steady trend at exactly 50 from x=25 to x=1500. The "ELU" line is a purple solid line with circle markers, maintaining a steady trend at approximately 48 from x=25 to x=1500. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is a pink dashed line with no markers, which remains constant at approximately 46 across the entire x-axis.
